en.bilal-muhammad: The venerable Shaykh Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: Sa`d b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Abu `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to us from his father Muhammad b. Khalid from Abu’l Bakhtari Wahab b. Wahab from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as) from Umm Salama (ra):

that she started crying one day. So, she was asked: What’s the matter with you? She said: My son, al-Husayn (as) has been killed and I haven’t seen the Messenger of Allah (s) since he died save this night. So, I said: May my father and my mother be sacrificed for you! Why is it that I see you so looking so haggard and pale? He said: I have been digging the grave of al-Husayn and the graves of his companions since this night.
